requirement: Transfer supported HWP5 body shapes and pictures into editable HWPX objects while preserving ownership, geometry, formatting, image resources, source bytes, safe rejection, Undo/Redo, and durable reopen.

implementation.targetStructure: Editable HWPX native shapes and picture with remapped object/instance IDs and an owned BinData relationship.
implementation.mapping: Bounded HWP5 portable snapshots preserve shape dimensions, rotation/flips, fill/stroke and description, and compare picture size, crop, layout, border and caption metadata fields. The Native picture fixture had no actual caption content. Picture bytes are imported into a new HWPX BinData part; the existing destination media remains owned by its original reference.

nativeX11.environment: Linux X11/Xvfb, private D-Bus, IBus Hangul
nativeX11.trustedPointerAndClipboard: PASS for source object selection/copy and destination paste
nativeX11.undoRedo: PASS for rectangle, ellipse, line, and picture; paste/Undo/Redo revisions 1 through 12
nativeX11.t009: PASS; saved, synced=true, changedSince=false at revision 12

mappedObjects.geometryAndFormatting: PASS; dimensions, rotation/flips, fill/stroke and descriptions preserved
mappedObjects.picturePortableFields: PASS; dimensions, offsets, treatAsChar, text wrap, border, description, crop, and caption metadata match the HWP5 source snapshot; the fixture hasCaption=false and no caption content

nativeX11.opc: PASS; only Contents/section0.xml and Contents/content.hpf changed; exactly BinData/image2.png was added with source picture bytes; other package parts and existing media were preserved; image1/image2 references are unique
nativeX11.sourceImmutability: PASS; HWP5 source bytes and object model unchanged
nativeX11.freshDocumentSessionReopen: PASS; saved HWPX closed and reopened into a clean document session, and all three transferred shapes and the transferred picture were selectable
nativeX11.negativeCases: PASS; rounded shape and malformed portable picture payload were refused atomically without target mutation

sessionIndicators.duringPasteUndoRedo: unpreserved=true while the destination was edited and dirty

cleanup.result: PASS; complete, proven, filesystemProven, exit 0, no survivors or process errors

limitations: Native acceptance covers HWP5 body Rectangle, Ellipse, Line and embedded Picture only; textbox, group, curve, and other complex objects were not exercised by this acceptance.
This is structured-object transfer for the verified subset, not full-document HWP5-to-HWPX conversion.
External Office/Hancom interoperability and Wayland, Windows, macOS were NOT RUN.
